The '''Blue Star Pirates''' were a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] crew that operated during the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They were heavily armed with military-grade weaponry supplied by [[Jalla Spree]].
